uniques: Comment [When it runs out, the blessed land meets an earthly calamity]

civilopediaText.text: Tier I: +5% strength. Dao marks (道痕) are engraved in a cultivator's body and aperture: the more of its path, the stronger its methods; marks of different paths interfere. They grow one tier every 20 turns on Standard for a path's Master of rank three or more, and an immortal also takes a tier from every immortal it kills and every heavenly tribulation it survives. Mortals hold at most tier II; rank seven needs tier II, rank eight tier III, the Venerable tier IV.
